defs.meaning: 全部的，整个的；完全的，绝对的；（公马）未经阉割的；（叶子）全缘的，边缘光滑的

examples.en: She spewed up the entire meal.
examples.zh: 她把吃的饭全吐出来了。

translations: (邮票)附贴在信封(或明信片、邮件包装纸等)上的

individual.mnemonic: en（进入）+ tir（拉）+ e → 整个的

pastExamSents.en: Robert is the best page turner I've had in my entire life.
pastExamSents.zh: 罗伯特是我一生中遇到的最好的翻页人。

pastExamSents.en: Any small interruption—a price check, a chatty customer—can have downstream effects, holding up an entire line.
pastExamSents.zh: 任何一个小小的中断，一个价格检查，一个喋喋不休的顾客，都会产生下游效应，拖住整个队伍。

pastExamSents.en: It is possible to walk or bike the entire 14 kilometers.
pastExamSents.zh: 人们可以步行或骑自行车走完全程14公里。

pastExamSents.en: You must show proof of a comprehensive health insurance valid in the target country for the entire period of the internship.
pastExamSents.zh: 在整个实习期间，必须出示所在国家有效的综合医疗保险证明。

pastExamSents.en: "I remember walking down the long hall and opening the door to my room to find an entire flock of seagulls," Burchill said in a recent letter of apology to the 4-star hotel.
pastExamSents.zh: 伯奇尔在最近给这家四星级酒店的道歉信中写道：“我记得我走过长长的大厅，打开房门，发现有一整群海鸥。”
